commentary: Today, DCE Iron Ore futures market was in the doldrums, with the most-traded contract I2509 closing at 708.5, down 1.32% for the day. Traders' willingness to sell was moderate. Steel mills mainly purchased as needed, with inquiries being average. The market transacƟon atmosphere was also average. In the Shandong region, the mainstream transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes were around 700 yuan/mt, down 5-8 yuan/mt from yesterday's prices. In the Tangshan region, the transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes were around 715-720 yuan/mt, down 5-10 yuan/mt from yesterday's prices. Recently, there have been frequent reports of producƟon cuts on the demand side. Today, the market received news that Tangshan would implement environmental protecƟon-driven producƟon restricƟons in stages in July. It is understood that currently, steel mills are mainly focusing on producƟon cuts and shutdowns of sintering machines and rotary kilns in the short term, while blast furnace maintenance plans have not yet been iniƟated.
